info.description: One row per photo slot on the public site (page heroes). The admin replaces the image, hides it (site falls back to illustrated art), or un-hides it. Seeded with licence-clean placeholder photography (MEDIA-1); placeholder=true until a real Nemocnica Snina photo replaces it. Department photos live on Department.image, physician portraits on Physician.avatar (real photos only).

slot.description: Slot id used by the site, e.g. about-hero, home-campus. Must match a PageHero slot in apps/web.

altSk.description: Alt text (Slovak). Heroes are decorative (h1 carries meaning) — used for in-page slots and the media library.

hidden.description: true = do not show any photo in this slot; the site renders its illustrated placeholder art instead.

placeholder.description: true = licence-clean stock placeholder, not a Nemocnica Snina photo. Set false when a real photo is uploaded. LAUNCH_CHECKLIST: no placeholder=true slot may remain visible at go-live.

credit.description: Attribution line. Rendered on-page when the licence requires it (CC BY-SA).

reusedFrom.description: When the slot had no photo of its own and reuses another slot's file (MEDIA-1: home-campus, patients-hero, contact-hero, telehealth-hero).
